values.condition: Approximate present-day distance of HE 0437-5439 from the Galactic Center, quoted in the introduction as ∼60 kpc

evidence.quote: This object is a9 M _ { \odot } main-sequence star that is ∼ 60 kpc from the Galactic Center, but only ∼ 15 kpc from the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC).

notes: All 21 Table 1 stars (HVS 1, HVS 4, HVS 5, HVS 6, HVS 7, HVS 8, HVS 9, HVS 10, HVS 12, HVS 13, HVS 14, HVS 15, HVS 16, HVS 17, HVS 18, HVS 19, HVS 20, HVS 21, HVS 22, HVS 23, HVS 24) are treated as follow_up: the paper explicitly revisits the 21 unbound stars detected by the HVS Survey (T:p1-b9, T:p1-b12) and analyzes all of them (T:p4-b2); their Gaia DR3 source IDs are from Table 1 (T:p4-b0; I:p4-b0). Five of these, HVS 5, HVS 8, HVS 14, HVS 17, and HVS 23, have p_MW < 0.05 and p_LMC < 0.05 in Table 1 and are called ambiguous/inconsistent with either center (T:p4-b2); this affects their origin interpretation, not the paper's retained unbound status. HVS 3 = HE 0437-5439 is a separate, previously known southern HVS (T:p2-b4) that the paper studies although it is explicitly not in the 21-star sample (T:p11-b5); it is included as follow_up despite the paper's LMC/Hills-origin conclusion, and no Gaia source ID for it is supplied. US 708 (HVS 2) is only mentioned as background (T:p2-b0) and is not analyzed, so it is not included.

HVS 1: Target identified as HVS 1 (Gaia DR3 source_id 577294697514301440) in Table 1 (T:p4-b0; I:p4-b0). The table's p_MW = 0.72 and p_LMC = 0.12 are p-values for Galactic Center versus LMC origin hypotheses, not probabilities of being bound/unbound, so they were not extracted as bound or unbound probabilities.

HVS 4: HVS 4 is the target (Gaia DR3 699811079173836928). In its Table 1 row (T:p4-b0), p_MW = 0.92 and p_LMC = 0.01 are p-values for Galactic-center and LMC-center origin hypotheses (see also Section 3, T:p3-b8), not bound or unbound probabilities, so they are not extracted as such. No individual right ascension, declination, or parallax is reported for HVS 4 in the supplied material.

HVS 5: Table 1 (T:p4-b0/I:p4-b0) identifies Gaia DR3 source_id 1069326945513133952 as HVS 5 and reports v_helio = 545.50 ± 4.30 km/s, pmra = 0.00 ± 0.08 mas/yr, pmdec = -0.99 ± 0.11 mas/yr, and d_helio = 44.20 ± 5.09 kpc. The table's p_MW and p_LMC columns are p-values for Galactic Center versus LMC origin hypotheses, not bound/unbound probabilities, so they are not recorded. No right ascension or declination is reported for this star in the supplied material. v_helio is interpreted as the heliocentric radial velocity, consistent with Section 3 stating that radial velocity, distance, and proper-motion uncertainties are sampled.

HVS 6: For HVS 6 (Gaia DR3 3867267443277880320), Table 1 reports v_helio, pmra, pmdec, and d_helio. The table's pMW and pLMC columns are p-values for Galactic Center versus LMC Center origin hypotheses, not bound/unbound probabilities, so they are not included here. No individual right ascension, declination, or parallax is reported for this star in the supplied material. The text's Galactocentric radius range 40–120 kpc refers to the sample rather than an individual measurement for HVS 6.

HVS 7: HVS 7 is identified by Gaia DR3 source_id 3799146650623432704 in Table 1. The table's p_MW and p_LMC values are p-values for Galactic Center versus LMC Center origin hypotheses, not bound/unbound probabilities, and are therefore not recorded as probability quantities. No right ascension, declination, parallax, per-star galactocentric radius, or Galactic rest-frame speed is reported for HVS 7 in the supplied material.

HVS 8: T:p4-b0 (Table 1, HVS 8) reports p_MW = 0.00 and p_LMC = 0.00, but Section 3 (T:p3-b8) defines these as p-values for the Galactic Center versus LMC Center origin hypotheses, not bound or unbound probabilities; they are therefore not recorded. No right ascension or declination is reported for HVS 8.

HVS 9: For HVS 9, Table 1 also lists p_MW = 0.44 and p_LMC = 0.77 with log(L_LMC/L_MW) = -0.13 (T:p4-b0), but these are p-values for the Galactic Center versus LMC origin hypotheses, not bound/unbound probabilities, so they are not recorded as bound_probability or unbound_probability. The paper does not report individual RA, Dec, parallax, galactocentric radius, or Galactic rest-frame total speed for HVS 9.

HVS 10: Target matched to HVS 10, Gaia DR3 source_id 3926757653770374272, in Table 1. The table's p_MW = 0.57 and p_LMC = 0.80 are p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC origin hypotheses, respectively, not bound/unbound probabilities, so they are not recorded as bound_probability or unbound_probability. The paper does not report right ascension, declination, or parallax for this star in the supplied material.

HVS 12: For HVS 12, Table 1 lists p_MW = 0.17 and p_LMC = 0.33; these are p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC origin hypotheses (T:p4-b0), not bound or unbound probabilities, so they were not extracted as bound_probability/unbound_probability. No individual right ascension, declination, parallax, galactocentric radius, or Galactic rest-frame speed is reported for HVS 12.

HVS 13: Target identified as HVS 13 (Gaia DR3 3804790100211231104). The table's p_MW and p_LMC columns are p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC origin hypotheses, not bound/unbound probabilities, so they are not reported as such. No equatorial right ascension or declination for this star is reported in the supplied material.

HVS 14: Table 1 (T:p4-b0; I:p4-b0) identifies HVS 14 as Gaia DR3 source_id 3859275333773935488 and reports p_MW = 0.00 and p_LMC = 0.00; these are p-values for Galactic Center versus LMC origin hypotheses, not bound/unbound probabilities, so they are not recorded as probability quantities. The paper does not report individual right ascension, declination, or parallax for HVS 14.

HVS 16: Table 1 reports p_MW=0.37 and p_LMC=0.73 for HVS 16, but Section 3 defines these as p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC origin hypotheses, not bound/unbound probabilities, so they are not recorded as bound_probability or unbound_probability. No right ascension, declination, parallax, galactocentric radius, or Galactic rest-frame speed is reported for this star.

HVS 17: Table 1 lists p_MW = 0.00 and p_LMC = 0.00 for HVS 17 (T:p4-b0). Section 3 defines these as p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC-center origin hypotheses, not probabilities that the star is bound or unbound, so they were not recorded as bound/unbound probabilities. The paper notes that HVS 17 remains ambiguous in origin (T:p4-b2). No right ascension, declination, or parallax is reported for HVS 17 in Table 1.

HVS 18: Table 1 lists p_MW = 0.71 and p_LMC = 0.00 for HVS 18 (log L_LMC/L_MW = -1.0), but these are p-values of the Galactic Center/LMC origin hypotheses (Section 3), not probabilities of being bound/unbound, so no bound or unbound probability is recorded. No right ascension or declination values for HVS 18 are reported in the paper; only its Gaia DR3 source_id (2872564390598678016) is provided. The v_helio value is a heliocentric line-of-sight velocity and is recorded as radial_velocity.

HVS 19: Table 1 (T:p4-b0) reports p_MW and p_LMC as p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC origin hypotheses, not as bound/unbound probabilities, so they are not extracted as bound_probability or unbound_probability. The paper does not report individual right ascension, declination, or parallax values for HVS 19; the table gives its Gaia DR3 source_id and astrometric proper motions only.

HVS 20: Target identified as HVS 20 (Gaia DR3 3800802102817768832) in Table 1. The Table 1 p_MW = 0.60 and p_LMC = 0.71 values are p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC origin hypotheses, not bound/unbound probabilities, so they are not recorded. No individual right ascension, declination, parallax, galactocentric radius, or Galactic rest-frame total speed is reported for this star.

HVS 21: Table 1 (T:p4-b0) lists p_MW = 0.85 and p_LMC = 0.66 for HVS 21; Section 3 (T:p4-b2) defines these as p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC-center origin hypotheses, not probabilities that the star is bound or unbound, so they are not recorded as bound_probability/unbound_probability. The paper does not report individual right ascension, declination, parallax, galactocentric radius, or total Galactic-rest-frame speed for HVS 21. The quoted 40–120 kpc Galactocentric-radius range is a sample range, not an individual value.

HVS 22: Table 1 (T:p4-b0, also imaged at I:p4-b0) lists HVS 22 / Gaia DR3 3897063727354575488 with v_helio = 597.80 ± 13.40 km/s, pmra = 0.07 ± 0.87 mas/yr, pmdec = -0.59 ± 0.67 mas/yr, d_helio = 83.98 ± 13.15 kpc. No right ascension, declination, parallax, Galactocentric radius, or total Galactic-rest-frame speed is reported for individual stars. The table's p_MW = 0.62 and p_LMC = 0.65 are p-values of the Galactic-Center and LMC-center origin hypotheses (not binding probabilities), and log(L_LMC/L_MW) = 0.17 is a likelihood ratio; these are origin-classification statistics rather than the bound/unbound probabilities defined here, so they are not extracted.

HVS 23: For HVS 23 (Gaia DR3 2681450921590663296), Table 1 also lists p_MW = 0.00, p_LMC = 0.00, and log(L_LMC/L_MW) = -0.26 (T:p4-b0). The p-values are hypothesis-test probabilities for Galactic Center or LMC origin, not bound or unbound probabilities, so they were not extracted as `bound_probability` or `unbound_probability`. No individual right ascension, declination, parallax, Galactocentric radius, or Galactic-rest-frame speed is reported for this star in the supplied material.

HVS 24: For HVS 24 (Gaia DR3 3810351984075984768), Table 1 (T:p4-b0) reports pMW = 0.05 and pLMC = 0.69, but Section 3 (T:p4-b2) defines these as p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC origin hypotheses, not bound or unbound probabilities. No right ascension, declination, or parallax for this star is reported in the supplied material.

HE 0437-5439: HE 0437-5439 (HVS 3) is not one of the 21 HVS Survey stars tabulated in Table 1, and the paper does not report its right ascension, declination, parallax, proper-motion components, or heliocentric radial velocity. The quoted \u223c15 kpc is its separation from the LMC, not a heliocentric distance, so it is not recorded as `distance`. The ejection velocity 870^{+69}_{-66} km/s is relative to the LMC (from Erkal et al. 2019) and is not the star's heliocentric/barycentric radial velocity or Galactic rest-frame speed, so it is not recorded.

HVS 15: For HVS 15 (Gaia DR3 3794074603484360704), Table 1 reports v_helio, pmra, pmdec, and d_helio, mapped here to radial_velocity, proper_motion_ra, proper_motion_dec, and distance. The tabulated p_MW = 0.02 and p_LMC = 0.45 are p-values for the Galactic Center and LMC origin hypotheses, not bound or unbound probabilities, so they are not mapped to bound_probability or unbound_probability. No right ascension, declination, parallax, galactocentric radius, Galactic rest-frame speed, or bound/unbound probability is reported specifically for this star.
